retained_diagnostics.detail: A guessed Worktrunk LICENSE-MIT path returned HTTP 404. The exact pinned source tree resolved the real combined LICENSE file; its bytes later matched the archive.
Both exact archive-digest GitHub attestations endpoints returned HTTP 404. Publisher checksums and GitHub asset digests passed; no attestation verification is claimed.

Test harness used a symlinked temporary path and globally mocked subprocess while platform metadata invoked uname/file. Resolved the test root and mocked platform metadata within tests. Production runner and frozen acceptance remained unchanged. Final 15 tests passed on both macOS and WSL.

findings: The original runner checked the binary against the installation receipt but did not bind that receipt to the frozen release pins.
A timed-out native command lost partial captured streams and lacked a journal entry.
retained_diagnostics.resolution: Current runner checks exact release identity, verifies retained archive against frozen digest, derives executable hash from archive bytes and checks native version. Timeout retains redacted partial streams, timed_out=true and null exit. Five regression tests added; revised native attempt passed. Original executed-run-v1.py and receipt-wsl.json retained byte-for-byte.
